AUTHOR: Catalán
TITLE: Automatic detection and classification of coastal Mediterranean fish from underwater images: Good practices for robust training
REGION: Mallorca (Andratx Bay wreck, Palma Bay), Balearic Islands; OBSEA, Catalonia, NE Spain
SPECIES: Coastal Mediterranean fish, e.g., Chromis chromis, Diplodus sargus, D. vulgaris, D. annularis, Serranus scriba, Seriola dumerilii, Oblada melanura, Coris julis, Mugilidae; classification runs with 4, 8, 14 classes
DATA: Own datasets: A (cabled wreck camera, Andratx, 6 m), B (drop-down/diver GoPro, Palma Bay, 5-20 m), external test C (second fixed camera, 8 m) and D (OBSEA observatory); A-C on Zenodo
V_EV: Methods: 'The camera ... was situated within the wreck (6 m depth)' ... 'The obtained images included depths ranging from 5 to 20 meters'
D2: A and B split into train / validation (~20% of images) / small test sets (A 15 images, B 13 images); C and D test-only
D_EV: Table 1 note: 'A and B datasets were split into training, validation and test sets.'; Methods: 'Four small test sets (images not belonging to the validation or training sets)'
R_EV: Table 4 reports YOLO mAP@0.5 on test sets A, B, C, D; Table 1: 'test sets C and D were obtained from different areas and backgrounds.'
C_EV: Models metrics: 'The P and R values from the nets were obtained so that they maximized the F1 score, thus achieving their best balance.'
E_EV: Models metrics: 'we calculated the F1 score and the mean average precision (mAP)' (detection/classification metrics only)
ARCH: YOLOv5m (Ultralytics) vs Faster R-CNN ResNet50 for fish detection; YOLOv5m vs EfficientNetV2 for species classification; Multiscale Retinex enhancement
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP@0.5; confusion matrices
NOTE: D: A/B train/val/test separated at image level; the paper does not say random or by date/deployment -> coded 이미지/프레임 무작위 as the image-level unit (lower-information alternative D1=NR -> D_ALL=NR). Dataset A is a fixed camera sending stills every 5 min, so temporal autocorrelation between sets is possible; not discussed. R: C = different fixed camera/model 4 m from wreck (8 m depth); D = OBSEA cabled observatory in Catalonia (different region and camera) -> R1=Y, R2=복수; Table 4 gives numeric in-domain vs external mAP -> R3=Y. V: depths reported (6, 5-20, 8 m); generic sentence on attenuation/haze is not about this data; no turbidity data -> V_ALL=P. E5 scenario excluded images with small/overlapping fish (label quality, not visibility). C: operating point chosen to maximize F1 (threshold value not stated) -> C1=Y, C_ALL=P. NCLASS=20 per abstract (Table 2 lists ~22 classes incl. 'Unidentified fish' and Diplodus sp.). PRE: YOLOv5m COCO, Faster R-CNN ImageNet. TYPE could also be 데이터셋+실험.
